# archestra_schedule_trigger_runs (Data Source)

Execution history for an `archestra_schedule_trigger`. Caps at `max_records` (default 1000); `truncated = true` signals more runs exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read execution history for a scheduled trigger.

data "archestra_schedule_trigger_runs" "daily_summary" {
  trigger_id  = archestra_schedule_trigger.daily_summary.id
  status      = "failed"
  max_records = 50
}

output "failed_daily_summary_count" {
  value = length(data.archestra_schedule_trigger_runs.daily_summary.runs)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `trigger_id` (String) Schedule trigger UUID.

### Optional

- `max_records` (Number) Maximum number of runs to pull into state (default 1000).
- `status` (String) Optional filter on run status: `running`, `success`, or `failed`.

### Read-Only

- `runs` (List of Object) Trigger runs ordered as the backend returns them (typically newest first). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runs))
- `total` (Number) Total count reported by the backend.
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when `max_records` capped the result.
